prior_year_events.impact_description: The Ogden discount rate announcement on 27 February 2017 created an overnight profitability challenge for the Syndicate and the motor insurance industry, leading to reserve strengthening for the 2015 year of account and deterioration on the forecast for the 2016 year of account due to reserve strengthening in damage losses.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 4.408 million in prior year claims provisions. This overall release occurred despite specific adverse developments noted for the 2015 and 2016 underwriting years. The 2015 year of account experienced reserve strengthening due to the impact of the Ogden discount rate change. The 2016 year of account's forecast deteriorated due to reserve strengthening in damage losses and the impact of the Ogden discount rate change on unearned business. The Ogden discount rate announcement in February 2017 was a significant regulatory change affecting the motor insurance market.
raw_causal_phrases: Ogden discount rate announcement on 27 February 2017
This discount rate change created an overnight profitability challenge
reserve strengthening for the impact of the change in Ogden discount rates
deterioration on the forecast at year end 2016 due to reserve strengthening in damage losses
results of the unearned business at the year end which was impacted by the change in Ogden discount rates

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported net of reinsurance in the 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' note. The gross claims development triangle was deemed unreliable for calculating prior year development due to the presence of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) premium payable for the 2015 year of account closure.
